title: Archean Basement (Peninsular Gneissic Complex) and Precambrian-Proterozoic Supergroups of India
source_note: Compiled from GSI memoirs/state geology volumes and peer-reviewed lithostratigraphic literature. Ranks (Supergroup/Group/Subgroup) and formation names for several basins (Mahakoshal, Chhattisgarh, Bhima, Kurnool) are still debated among workers and have been revised multiple times; alternative schemes are noted where relevant. Member-level names exist only for a minority of formations. Cross-check against the latest official GSI Stratigraphic Chart of India for authoritative current usage.

archean_basement.name: Peninsular Gneissic Complex (PGC)
archean_basement.description: Composite basement of TTG gneisses, migmatites, and granites on which the Proterozoic supergroups were unconformably deposited. Not stratified in the formal Group/Formation sense; regionally subdivided and named differently across cratons.

components.name: Older Metamorphic Group / Sargur Group type supracrustals
components.note: Oldest enclaves within PGC, includes BIF, ultramafics, pelites

components.name: Closepet Granite
components.note: Late Archean granite intrusion, often mapped separately from PGC gneisses

components.name: Bundelkhand Gneissic Complex (BnGC)
components.note: Basement to Bijawar Group and Vindhyan Supergroup

components.name: Chhotanagpur Granite Gneissic Complex (CGGC)
components.note: Basement/host to Mahakoshal-equivalent supracrustals in the east

components.name: Banded Gneissic Complex (BGC)
components.note: Basement to Aravalli and Delhi Supergroups, includes Bhilwara Supergroup gneisses

components.name: Sandur/Dharwar Gneissic Complex
components.note: Basement to Cuddapah and Kurnool basins

supergroups.name: Dharwar Supergroup
supergroups.unconformably_overlies: Peninsular Gneissic Complex (Peninsular Gneiss / Older Metamorphic Group)

groups.name: Sargur Group
groups.note: Oldest supracrustal assemblage; treated by some as pre-Dharwar basement enclaves rather than base of the Supergroup

supergroups.name: Aravalli Supergroup
supergroups.region: Aravalli Range, Rajasthan (older than and unconformably overlain by Delhi Supergroup)
supergroups.unconformably_overlies: Banded Gneissic Complex / Bhilwara Supergroup basement

supergroups.name: Mahakoshal Supergroup
supergroups.rank_note: Most literature ranks this as the 'Mahakoshal Group' (a greenstone/supracrustal belt), not a full Supergroup; included here at Supergroup level per request, with Group as the next rank down
supergroups.region: Son Valley / Central Indian Tectonic Zone (CITZ), Madhya Pradesh - Uttar Pradesh border

formations.name: Sleemanabad (Saleemnabad) Formation
formations.note: Carbonates, bedded/massive chert, BIF, quartz arenite

groups.name: Mahakoshal Group (eastern sector - Chitrangi-Agori-Parsoi scheme)
groups.note: Alternative formation scheme used by Nair, Jain & Yedekar (1995) for the eastern part of the belt; intruded by the Dudhi Granitoid Complex

supergroups.name: Delhi Supergroup
supergroups.region: Aravalli Range, Rajasthan (unconformably overlies Aravalli Supergroup)

supergroups.name: Chhattisgarh Supergroup
supergroups.region: Chhattisgarh Basin (Hirri and Baradwar sub-basins), Bastar Craton, Chhattisgarh/Odisha

groups.name: Singhora Group
groups.note: Basal group, restricted to the Singhora sub-basin

groups.name: Kharsiya Group
groups.note: Newly proposed uppermost group, Baradwar sub-basin

supergroups.name: Vindhyan Supergroup
supergroups.age: Paleoproterozoic to Neoproterozoic (c. 1700-650 Ma, age still debated)
supergroups.region: Vindhyan Basin, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan
supergroups.unconformably_overlies: Bundelkhand Gneissic Complex / Bijawar Group / Mahakoshal Group

supergroups.name: Bhima Supergroup
supergroups.rank_note: Almost universally ranked as the 'Bhima Group' (smallest Proterozoic basin in India), not a Supergroup; included here at Supergroup level per request
supergroups.region: Bhima Basin, Kalaburagi/Yadgir districts (Karnataka) and Mahbubnagar/Rangareddy districts (Telangana)
supergroups.unconformably_overlies: Dharwar Craton basement (Adki Hill Conglomerate marks the Archean-Proterozoic boundary)

groups.name: Sedam Subgroup
groups.note: Ranked as Subgroup within Bhima Group by Mishra et al. (1987); shown here at group level for consistency of hierarchy

formations.name: Shahabad Formation
formations.note: Also called Kurkunta Formation (Malur & Nagendra, 1994); limestone-dominated

formations.name: Harwal Shale Formation
formations.note: Also referred to as Harwal-Gogi Shale; youngest unit, overlain by Deccan Trap

supergroups.name: Kurnool Supergroup
supergroups.rank_note: Conventionally ranked as the 'Kurnool Group', unconformably overlying the Cuddapah Supergroup (Nallamalai Group) rather than being part of it; included here at Supergroup level per request
supergroups.region: Kurnool Basin, Andhra Pradesh (northern part of Cuddapah Basin)
